raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
H = H _ {\mathrm {a t o m}} - B _ {0} \left(\gamma_ {0} L _ {z} + \gamma S _ {z}\right) + \frac {e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {Z} \left(x _ {i} ^ {2} + y _ {i} ^ {2}\right),
$$

其中 $L _ { z }$ 和 $S _ { z }$ 是所有电子总的电子轨道和自旋角动量

(a) 将含有 $B _ { 0 }$ 的项作为微扰，计算氨原子基态能级的移动，精确到 $B _ { 0 }$ 的二阶修正.假定氨原子基态由下式给出:

$$
\psi_ {0} = \psi_ {1 0 0} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {1 0 0} (r _ {2}) \frac {| \uparrow \downarrow \rangle - | \downarrow \uparrow \rangle}{\sqrt {2}},
$$

其中 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 }$ 指的是类氢原子基态 $\left( Z = 2 \right)$ ).

(b) 利用习题 .4 中的结论，计算氨原子的磁化率.假设密度为 $0 . 1 6 6 ~ \mathrm { k g } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 3 }$ ，求磁化率的具体数值.注释实验值为一 $- 1 . 0 \times 1 0 ^ { - 9 }$ (负号表明氮是抗磁的).通过增加轨道半径来考虑屏蔽效应(见 8.2 节)，数值结果可以和实验更加接近.
raw_problem.solution_text:
a)

$$
H ^ {\prime} = - B _ {0} \left(\gamma_ {0} L _ {z} + \gamma S _ {z}\right) + \frac {e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {Z} \left(x _ {i} ^ {2} + y _ {i} ^ {2}\right),
$$

一阶微扰为

$$
E ^ {1} = - B _ {0} \left(\gamma_ {0} \left\langle L _ {z} \right\rangle + \gamma \left\langle S _ {z} \right\rangle\right) + \frac {e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {Z} \left\langle x _ {i} ^ {2} + y _ {i} ^ {2} \right\rangle ,
$$

二阶微扰为

$$
E ^ {2} = \sum_ {n \neq 0} \frac {\left| \langle \psi_ {n} | - B _ {0} (\gamma_ {0} L _ {z} + \gamma S _ {z}) + \frac {e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {Z} (x _ {i} ^ {2} + y _ {i} ^ {2}) | \psi_ {0} \rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {0} - E _ {n}}.
$$

只保留到 $B _ { 0 } ^ { 2 }$ 级，则

$$
E ^ {2} = B _ {0} ^ {2} \sum_ {n \neq 0} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {n} \right| \left(\gamma_ {0} L _ {z} + \gamma S _ {z}\right) \left| \psi_ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {0} - E _ {n}}.
$$

由于

$$
\begin{array}{l} L _ {z} | \psi_ {1 0 0} (r _ {1}) \rangle | \psi_ {1 0 0} (r _ {2}) \rangle = \left(L _ {z} ^ {1} + L _ {z} ^ {2}\right) | \psi_ {1 0 0} (r _ {1}) \rangle | \psi_ {1 0 0} (r _ {2}) \rangle = 0, \\ S _ {z} \frac {| \uparrow \downarrow \rangle - | \downarrow \uparrow \rangle}{\sqrt {2}} = \left(S _ {z} ^ {1} + S _ {z} ^ {2}\right) \frac {| \uparrow \downarrow \rangle - | \downarrow \uparrow \rangle}{\sqrt {2}} = 0, \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta E = E ^ {1} + E ^ {2} = \frac {e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {Z} \left\langle x _ {i} ^ {2} + y _ {i} ^ {2} \right\rangle \\ = \frac {2 e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \left(\left\langle x _ {i} ^ {2} \right\rangle + \left\langle y _ {i} ^ {2} \right\rangle\right) \\ = \frac {2 e ^ {2}}{8 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \frac {2}{3} \left<   r ^ {2} \right> = \frac {e ^ {2}}{6 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \left<   r ^ {2} \right > . \\ \end{array}
$$

由 $\left. r ^ { 2 } \right. = { \frac { 3 a ^ { 2 } } { Z ^ { 2 } } }$ 芸， 所以

$$
\Delta E = \frac {e ^ {2}}{6 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \left(\frac {3 a ^ {2}}{Z ^ {2}}\right) = \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 m} B _ {0} ^ {2} \left(\frac {a ^ {2}}{Z ^ {2}}\right).
$$

(b) 由习题 .4 并结合 (a) 中结论，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \chi = \mu_ {0} \frac {\partial M}{\partial B _ {0}} = - \frac {N}{V} \mu_ {0} \frac {\partial^ {2} E _ {0}}{\partial B _ {0} ^ {2}} = - \frac {N}{V} \mu_ {0} \frac {e ^ {2}}{m} \left(\frac {a}{Z}\right) ^ {2} \\ = - \left(\frac {1}{m / N}\right) \left(\frac {m}{V}\right) \mu_ {0} \frac {e ^ {2}}{m} \left(\frac {a}{Z}\right) ^ {2} \\ = - \left(\frac {\rho}{m _ {\mathrm {H e}}}\right) \mu_ {0} \frac {e ^ {2}}{m} \left(\frac {a}{Z}\right) ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

将 $Z = 2$ 代入上式，得 $- 6 . 2 \times 1 0 ^ { - 1 0 }$ ，如果考虑电于的屏蔽效应lW $Z = 1 . 6 9$ ，得 $- 8 . 7 \times 1 0 ^ { - 1 0 }$ •

串串串习题 7.51 有时不需要将 $\psi _ { n } ^ { 1 }$ 用无微扰波函数(方程 (7.11)) 展开，而能直接求解方程 (7.10). 这里有两个非常好的例子

# (a) 氢原子基态的斯塔克效应

(i) 求处于恒定外电场 $E _ { \mathrm { e x t } }$ xt，中的氢原子基态能量的一阶修正(见习题 .45).示尝试如下形式的解:

$$
\left(A + B r + C r ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \cos \theta ;
$$

你的问题是找到常数 $A , B$ 和 $C$ 来解方程 (7.10).

利用方程 (7.14) 确定基态能量的二阶修正(在习题 .45(a) 中已经知道它的一阶修正为零).答案: $- m \left[ 3 a ^ { 2 } e E _ { \mathrm { e x t } } / ( 2 \hbar ) \right] ^ { 2 }$ .  
(b) 如果质子电偶极矩为 $p$ 氢原子中电子的势能将受到如下大小量的扰动

$$
H ^ {\prime} = - \frac {e p \cos \theta}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} r ^ {2}}.
$$

(i) 求解方程 (7.10)，给出基态波函数一阶修正.  
(ii) 证明:原子总的电偶极矩在一阶近似下(令人吃惊地)为零.  
(iii) 利用方程 (7.14) 确定基态能量的二阶修正.一阶修正是多少呢?

# 解答 (a)

(i) 对氢原子基杏 $n = 0$ ，将 $n = 0$ 代入方程 (7.10) ，得

$$
\left(H ^ {0} - E _ {0} ^ {0}\right) \psi_ {0} ^ {1} = - \left(H ^ {\prime} - E _ {0} ^ {1}\right) \psi_ {0} ^ {0}.
$$

氢原子基态哈密顿量可写为

$$
\begin{array}{l} H ^ {0} = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla^ {2} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} r ^ {2}} \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla^ {2} + \frac {2}{a r}\right), \quad \left(a \equiv \frac {4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2}}{m e ^ {2}}\right), \\ E _ {0} ^ {0} = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m a ^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$H ^ { \prime } = e E _ { \mathrm { e x t } } r \cos \theta$ , 由习题 .45(a)) $E _ { 0 } ^ { 1 } = 0 ; \psi _ { 0 } ^ { 0 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { \pi a ^ { 3 } } } e ^ { - r / a }$ .设 $\psi _ { 0 } ^ { 1 } = f \left( r \right) \mathrm { e } ^ { - r / a } \cos \theta$ ，将以上诸式代入方程 ，同时参考以下球坐标中的拉普拉斯算符表示

$$
\nabla^ {2} = \frac {1}{r ^ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(r ^ {2} \frac {\partial}{\partial r}\right) + \frac {1}{r ^ {2} \sin \theta} \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta}\right) + \frac {1}{r ^ {2} \sin^ {2} \theta} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}},
$$

所以，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \nabla^ {2} \psi_ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {\cos \theta}{r ^ {2}} \left\{r ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} r} [ f (r) \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} ] \right\} + \frac {f (r) \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a}}{r ^ {2} \sin \theta} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} \theta} (\sin \theta \frac {\mathrm {d} \cos \theta}{\mathrm {d} \theta}) \\ = \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \cos \theta \left[ \left(f ^ {\prime \prime} - \frac {2}{a} f ^ {\prime} + \frac {f}{a ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {2}{r} \left(f ^ {\prime} - \frac {f}{a}\right) - \frac {2 f}{r ^ {2}} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

代入方程 (7.10) 并化筒，最后得

$$
f ^ {\prime \prime} - \frac {2 f ^ {\prime}}{a} + \frac {2 f ^ {\prime}}{r} - \frac {2 f}{r ^ {2}} = \frac {2 m e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}}}{\hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} r.
$$

令 $f \left( r \right) = A + B r + C r ^ { 2 }$ 于是有

$$
- \frac {1}{r ^ {2}} \left(A + B r + C r ^ {2}\right) + \frac {1}{r} \left(B + 2 C r\right) - \frac {1}{a} \left(B + 2 C r\right) + C = \frac {m e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}}}{\hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} r.
$$

比较两边 $r$ 的不同次幕的系数可以得到关于 $B$ 和 $C$ 的一次方程组并求解，得

$$
A = 0, \quad B = - \frac {m e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}}}{\hbar^ {2}} \sqrt {\frac {a}{\pi}}, \quad C = - \frac {m e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}}}{2 \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a}}.
$$

llP

$$
\psi_ {0} ^ {1} = - \frac {m e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}}}{2 \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a}} \left(r ^ {2} + 2 a r\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \cos \theta .
$$

己知披函数的一阶修正，则能量的二阶修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {0} ^ {2} = \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right\rangle \\ = - \frac {1}{\sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \frac {m e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}}}{2 \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a}} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} (e E _ {\mathrm {e x t}} r \cos \theta) (r ^ {2} + 2 r a) \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \cos \theta r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {m e ^ {2} E _ {\mathrm {e x t}} ^ {2}}{a ^ {2} \hbar^ {2}} \underbrace {\int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \left(r ^ {5} + 2 a r ^ {4}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r} _ {5! (a / 2) ^ {6} + 2 a 4! (a / 2) ^ {5}} \underbrace {\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta} _ {2 / 3} \\ = - \frac {9 m e ^ {2} a ^ {4} E _ {\mathrm {e x t}} ^ {2}}{4 \hbar^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b)

(刊用(时 中的结果，此时 $H ^ { \prime } = - { \frac { e p \cos \theta } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } r ^ { 2 } } }$ ，方程 (7 叫变为

$$
f ^ {\prime \prime} + 2 f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {1}{r} - \frac {1}{a}\right) - \frac {2 f}{r ^ {2}} = - \frac {2 m e p}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \frac {1}{r ^ {2}}.
$$

比较两边关于 $r$ 不同放军的系数后，得

$$
f \left(r\right) = \frac {m e p}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}}
$$

是一个常数.所以基态披函数的一阶修正为

$$
\psi_ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {m e p}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a} \cos \theta .
$$

在质子电偶极矩的影响下，电子也会产生相应的电偶极矩，下面在电子被函数的一阶近似条件下来计算该电偶极矩的平均值

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle p _ {e} \rangle = \langle - e r \cos \theta \rangle \\ = - e \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} + \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right| r \cos \theta \left| \psi_ {0} ^ {0} + \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right\rangle \\ = - e \left(\left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \right| r \cos \theta | \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \rangle + 2 \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \right| r \cos \theta | \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \rangle + \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right| r \cos \theta | \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \rangle\right) \\ = - e \left(\langle z \rangle + 2 \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \right| r \cos \theta \left| \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right\rangle + \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right| r \cos \theta \left| \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right\rangle\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

由于氢原子的 轨道被函数是球对称的 所以上式的第一项为零.最后一项属于高阶项(只考虑一阶修正)，可以舍弃，所以电子云产生的电偶极矩平均值为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle p _ {e} \right\rangle = - 2 e \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \right| r \cos \theta \left| \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right\rangle \\ = - \frac {m e ^ {2} p}{2 \pi^ {2} \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2} a ^ {3}} \int r \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \cos^ {2} \theta r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {m e ^ {2} p}{\pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2} a ^ {3}} \underbrace {\int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {3} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r} _ {3! (a / 2) ^ {4}} \underbrace {\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin \theta \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta} _ {2 / 3} \\ = - \frac {m e ^ {2} p a}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2}} \\ = - p. \\ \end{array}
$$

电子的电偶极矩正好抵消了质子的电偶极矩，因此原子的电偶极矩在一阶近似下为零.

(iü) 由于氢原子的日轨道波函数是球对称的，因 $\langle \cos \theta \rangle = 0$ , 基态能量的一阶修正是零.下面考虑二阶修正，

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {0} ^ {2} = \left\langle \psi_ {0} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {0} ^ {1} \right\rangle \\ = \int \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a}}{\sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}}\right) \left(- \frac {e p \cos \theta}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} r ^ {2}}\right) \left(\frac {m e p}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar^ {2} \sqrt {\pi a ^ {3}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- r / a}\right) \cos \theta r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {2 \pi m e ^ {2} p ^ {2}}{\left(4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar\right) ^ {2} \pi a ^ {3}} \underbrace {\int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r} _ {a / 2} \underbrace {\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin \theta \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta} _ {2 / 3} \\ = - \frac {2}{3} m \left(\frac {e p}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} \hbar a}\right) ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

代入玻尔基态能量 $E _ { 1 } = - \frac { m e ^ { 4 } } { 2 \hbar ^ { 2 } \left( 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } \right) ^ { 2 } }$ mé 一 能量的二阶修正可以表示为

$$
E _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {4}{3} \left(\frac {p}{e a}\right) ^ {2} E _ {1}.
$$
